summary: From the LAX gate on the 27th to wheels down in Atlanta on the 16th. Seoul in transit, three days alone in Xi'an, the Z165 thirty hours up the Qinghai-Tibet railway, then the eight-day Everest Base Camp tour with Jeff and Kamana — the only stretch you are not on your own. They fly out of Lhasa on the 10th; the five nights in Shanghai are solo again.
title: China & Tibet
